sources.name: OCID — Object Clutter Indoor Dataset (TU Wien ACIN)
sources.terms_notes: CC-BY 4.0 International declared on the official TU Wien Research Data record; repository Terms of Use at https://researchdata.tuwien.at/tuw/terms-of-use accepted by the downloader per D-014
sources.licence_review_status: approved-2026-09-07 (D-014) — CC-BY 4.0 research use approved for tiny example publication with attribution; YCB/ARID-derived objects excluded from redistribution unless verified; archive stays outside Git
sources.selected_subset: ARID20/table/top/seq01, ARID20/table/top/seq02, ARID20/table/bottom/seq01, and ARID20/table/bottom/seq02; each converted in source order and reverse order as 21-frame scenarios (8 scenarios, 168 replayed frames total); output manifest SHA-256 values are recorded in <KYRA_DATA_ROOT>/ocid/verification_summary.json

exclusions.detail: all OCID sequences outside the four named 21-frame ARID20 tabletop sequences were excluded from this bounded recorded-data smoke run
converted examples whose objects originate from the YCB/ARID sets are excluded from redistribution unless their object provenance is verified (D-014, 2026-09-07)
